newsitem.title: USA: Bedford Bancshares names top executives.
newsitem.headline: Bedford Bancshares names top executives.

text.p: Bedford Bancshares Inc said on Friday its board named Hugh Bond chairman and Harold Neal president of the company and its Bedford Federal Savings Bank unit.
Both men have served as directors of the company.
Bond, a former owner and president of Scott and Bond Real Estate and Insurance Co, fills the vacancy created by the death last month of T. Glynn Bradley, the company said.
Neal adds the title of president to his role as chief executive officer, the company said.
